lessons_used: Choose_path redesign produced the only winning test, though results across two tests remain mixed with no clear effect in the second test.
No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for adoption redesigns, choose_path copy, home notifications, home wait info, and sign-in copy changes.
Sign-in reordering showed no clear effect in its first test and caused a significant drop in its second test.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, including all finish screen variations, home redesigns, and sign-in layout changes.
Predictions were systematically too high in Round 1 and severely overestimated the guided customizer in Round 5.
Predictions were too low for the winning choose_path redesign test, which was predicted to decrease performance but resulted in a significant win.

candidates.title: Carousel Companion Path Discovery
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a carousel layout with distinct animated path options highlighting quick start vs custom pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path has a median completion time of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation for a subset of users.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Begin
choose_path.body: Select a quick pre-built companion or build your custom desktop pet.

guard.reason: The redesign maintains the core job of choose_path by offering both adoption and custom pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesign produced the only past winner, but full redesign carries engineering cost.

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Account Pet Protection Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint below the sign-in options explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account reset issues.
candidates.why: Support receives the highest volume of sign-in emails (8 emails) regarding pets going missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet securely. Existing pets will be automatically restored to your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory hint to the sign-in screen is valid and does not violate any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from highest email volume combined with high drop-off at sign-in step.

candidates.title: Pet Creation Pre-Flight Summary Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before adoption certificate that allows users to review pet traits and avatar settings before final rendering.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and support receives emails about custom pet generation failures.

new_summary_review.headline: Review Your Pet Companion
new_summary_review.body: Check your selected traits before bringing your pet to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a summary review screen inside onboarding before adoption certificate is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off, but adding new screens previously hurt adoption conversion.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Link Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in options block with prominent persistence indicators showing account sync status.
candidates.why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% with long mean dropoff times (567s) and major support issues around account pet loss.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Stage Layout Custom Photo Upload Studio
candidates.change: Redesign upload_photos screen into a stage layout with clear photo visual dropzones and live sample preview cards.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or looks wrong for users (3 support tickets), and adoption drops significantly (60.9% dropoff).

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos for Custom Rendering
upload_photos.body: Provide clear photos of your pet from multiple angles for best accuracy.

guard.reason: replacement for 'upload_photos.photo_upload' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['photo_picker'] with real words

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Launch Progress Timer
candidates.change: Add an explicit countdown timer and status rendering indicator on the waiting screen to manage user expectation while pet assets load.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-offs when users think the app is frozen.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace
waiting.body: Your pet is being initialized. It will appear on your screen shortly.

guard.reason: Adding a timer on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 5 since it represents a real wait during pet initialization.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes showed 0.0% effect across past tests despite long mean duration.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Controls Interactive Guide
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro to a split layout with interactive visual callouts demonstrating desktop controls, hide/show shortcuts, and pet interaction.
candidates.why: Finish step dropoff is 35.2% and support receives emails about post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Click your pet to interact, drag to move across windows, or access pet settings from your system tray.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro with desktop controls visual guide is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step and support complaints, but past finish layout/redesigns yielded negative lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a new confirmation screen at the finish step that prompts the user to verify if the pet is visible on their desktop background.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple bug reports stating that the pet does not show on the desktop or the app fails to appear after finish.

new_desktop_check.headline: Is Your Pet Visible on Desktop?
new_desktop_check.body: Look around your screen! If your pet is hiding or off-screen, click below to center it.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses bug reports, but adding verification screens tends to increase drop-off at finish.

candidates.title: Waiting Background Audio Signal
candidates.change: Enable background audio cue and desktop system notification switch on the waiting screen when asset building finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait stage takes a long time (mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and miss when onboarding completes.

guard.reason: Adding a subtle audio cue and notification option on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications showed modest positive trend (+1.5%) across 3 historical tests.

candidates.title: Story Screen Instant Path Choice Clarification
candidates.change: Update story screen copy to clearly differentiate instant adoption vs custom upload path from the very beginning.
candidates.why: Choose path screen drop-off is 21% and mean duration is 514s, indicating users are unsure which path suits them best.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: Adopt a ready-to-play pet instantly or create a custom pet from your own photos in just a few steps.

guard.reason: Updating story copy continues to introduce the pet while clarifying available paths.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak, but choose_path copy changes previously resulted in negative lift (-0.8%).

picked: Sign-In Existing Account Pet Protection Hint

decisions.title: Sign-In Existing Account Pet Protection Hint

lessons_next: Choose_path redesign produced a winning test, but results across multiple tests remain mixed with no clear effect in subsequent attempts.
No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for home notifications, sign-in copy, choose_path copy, home wait info, and adoption redesigns.
Sign-in reordering and adoption new flows showed no clear effect or resulted in significant performance drops across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, including all finish screen variations, home redesigns, sign-in hints/layouts, and adoption new screens.
Predictions systematically overestimated early tests and complex customizers while underestimating both winning tests, which were predicted to reduce performance.
